verdict.rationale: 2FAS's own homepage documents token customization with groups, badges, icons, and labels, which covers the folders/groups and service-icon parts of the story. The evidence never mentions search, and the support rests on a single one-line marketing claim with no detailed docs or hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: in-app token search, detailed documentation of grouping and icon behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration of organizing dozens of tokens for quick access.

support.subject: As a power user, I can keep dozens of tokens organized — search, folders or groups, and service icons — so the right code is always two taps away
